name: io.github.p1xelapp/solana-nft-mcp
description: Read-only Solana NFT data for AI: ownership history, custody rules, marketplace sales and floors.

environmentVariables.name: OPENSEA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own OpenSea API key; without it the server issues a free one on first use.

environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_NFT_MCP_NO_AUTO_KEYS
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to stop the server from issuing an OpenSea key for you.

environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_NFT_MCP_NO_UPDATE_CHECK
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to skip the once-per-start npm version check.
